description: This file implements a cooldown cache mechanism for a router, wrapping caching logic with specific cooldown handling for model deployments and exceptions. It defines classes and methods for adding cooldowns, fetching active cooldowns, and determining the minimal cooldown among models, with reliance on external caching, logging, and utility modules.

classes.name: CooldownCacheValue
classes.description: Typed dictionary representing the data stored in the cooldown cache, including exception info, status code, timestamp, and cooldown duration.

classes.name: CooldownCache
classes.description: Class managing cooldown logic for model deployment errors, integrating cache storage and retrieval, cooldown calculation, and masking sensitive data in exceptions.

methods.description: Adds a deployment-specific cooldown entry into the cache, with appropriate TTL.

methods.name: str get_cooldown_cache_key(model_id: str)
methods.description: Static method to generate a consistent cache key for a given model ID, memoized for efficiency.

methods.name: List[Tuple[str,CooldownCacheValue]] async_get_active_cooldowns( self, model_ids: List[str], parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] )
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves list of active cooldowns for specified models from cache.

methods.description: Synchronously retrieves list of active cooldowns for specified models from cache.

methods.name: float get_min_cooldown( self, model_ids: List[str], parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] )
methods.description: Calculates the minimum cooldown time across a set of models based on cache data.
